Besides Heather's strange upbringing and how it has affected her personality, genetics has been much more kind to her with other parts of her body, her breasts are huge, especially in comparison to most other female dinosaurs in her class at Volcano High, as well as just having fat and thickness in the all the right spots, wide hips, big butt, at least something was fair to her besides her crippling autism. On the farm she wears a set of overalls with nothing usually on underneath, she cannot grasp modesty enough to do that. Strangely enough she has a thick southern American accent, very noticeable when she speaks. Heather's eyes will always be cross-eyed unless she is focusing really hard on something. Her scales are of an orange creme color, with a blonde head of hair styled in a classical wavy bangs type, a red headband going across her head to tie it all together and keep it properly groomed. She does not usually wear bras, not only because she doesn't own any, but also of the fact of her lack of knowledge of such modesty, as well as being a trigger for her sensory issues, so they are avoided. Heather's shoulders have a set of freckles on each, with a horizontal repeating tiger scratch pattern across her snout and tail in a single color tone of a lighter yellow, complementing her orange creme scales.
